entities.name: Emrakul, the Aeons Torn
entities.description: One of the three legendary Eldrazi on Zendikar; its brood lineage has spongy latticework, ropy tentacles and deep blue, ochre and magenta coloration.

entities.name: Ulamog, the Infinite Gyre
entities.description: One of the three legendary Eldrazi on Zendikar; its lineage has skull-like bony plates, tentacles and bifurcated arms.

entities.name: Kozilek, Butcher of Truth
entities.description: One of the three legendary Eldrazi on Zendikar; its lineage has glossy black blade-like plates, insectoid bodies and odd eyes.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Astral monstrosities trapped on Zendikar that have risen again, each spawning a brood lineage of minions.

entities.name: Eldrazi Spawn
entities.description: Small squirming mana-infused pupae of each lineage, which store energy for greater Eldrazi to consume.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where the three Eldrazi were trapped and have risen again.

entities.name: Merfolk scholars
entities.description: Scholars who speculate about the Emrakul lineage's latticework.

events.summary: The three legendary Eldrazi trapped on Zendikar rise again, each spawning a brood lineage of minions.

relations.note: Spawn serve the greater Eldrazi of their lineage and are consumed to hatch greater Eldrazi.
relations.quote: Eldrazi spawn are small—mere infants compared to the Brobdingnagian monstrosities they serve

relations.note: The Eldrazi were trapped on Zendikar.
relations.quote: The three legendary Eldrazi trapped on Zendikar
